meta.title: Fix XAML binding warnings in DeviceTests.Runners by adding x:DataType attributes
meta.body_summary: Eliminate 37 XC0022 XAML binding warnings by adding x:DataType attributes to enable compiled bindings, claiming improved runtime performance in DeviceTests.Runners UI.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added x:DataType but incorrectly changed ViewModel command signatures; maintainer CHANGES_REQUESTED, agent attempted fix but PR closed due to unresolved C# mistakes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 75 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume, consistent with a compact XAML optimization fix. However, it was closed because the C# changes introduced by the agent were incorrect and not fully resolved, failing the correctness review.

review_details.concern_detail: mattleibow CHANGES_REQUESTED: all C# ViewModel changes were wrong; commands should accept ViewModel types, not SelectionChangedEventArgs. He referred to MAUI compiled bindings docs and gave inline corrections for XAML and C#.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate 37 XC0022 warnings and improve runtime performance via compiled bindings.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after noting AI could not do the fix correctly without human input.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent struggled with the MAUI compiled binding interaction between XAML markup and C# command signatures, failing to implement the reviewer-corrected pattern despite attempts, illustrating a framework‑specific knowledge gap.

detection_detail.code_reading: mattleibow reviewed the C# ViewModel changes, identified they were incorrect, and provided inline examples of the proper SelectionChangedCommandParameter pattern.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or runtime measurements were provided; the performance claim is based solely on the removal of compile‑time warnings, with no actual runtime before/after data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the CHANGES_REQUESTED review, Copilot attempted a fix re‑introducing correct command types and x:DataType, but the maintainer closed the PR, stating the AI could not complete the fix without human help.

core_change_summary.description: Added x:DataType attributes to three XAML pages to enable compiled bindings, modified CollectionView bindings by removing element-reference SelectionChangedCommandParameter or incorrectly changing C# command signatures, then reverted ViewModels to accept ViewModel types and added proper SelectionChangedCommandParameter with x:DataType in the final commit.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: TestResultPage.xaml had only a 3-line change adding x:DataType.
change_trajectory: Initial plan commit; no file changes.
Second commit: added x:DataType to XAML containers and restructured bindings, removing SelectionChangedCommandParameter.
Third commit: incorrectly changed ViewModel commands to accept SelectionChangedEventArgs.
Fourth commit (after CHANGES_REQUESTED): reverted ViewModel changes back to ViewModel types and added SelectionChangedCommandParameter with x:DataType per reviewer's inline suggestions.
Maintainer closed the PR, indicating the overall solution was still not satisfactory.

review_signals.summary: Formal CHANGES_REQUESTED: none of the C# file changes are correct; pointed to MAUI compiled bindings documentation.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot attempted fix in commit d76786b6.

review_signals.summary: Multiple inline comments: SelectionChangedCommandParameter missing x:DataType in XAML, C# command types should be ViewModel types (e.g., TestAssemblyViewModel?) not SelectionChangedEventArgs.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted ViewModels and added x:DataType to SelectionChangedCommandParameter in response.

review_signals.summary: Copilot acknowledged the mistake and claimed to have corrected the approach by reverting C# changes and using proper x:DataType bindings.
Closed the PR stating AI could not fix it without a human; implemented a different solution afterwards.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with XAML x:DataType additions and modified ViewModel commands to accept SelectionChangedEventArgs.
mattleibow reviewed, CHANGES_REQUESTED with inline comments showing correct patterns, and pointed to documentation.
Copilot responded with a fix commit that reverted ViewModels and added x:DataType to parameter bindings.
mattleibow closed the PR, stating the AI could not complete the work and subsequently created a better fix himself.
